description: This file defines a Room database for the Quick Transfer app, providing access to Entity tables for profiles, connections, and transfer history, along with singleton access methods.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase, defines DAOs for Profile, Connection, and TransferHistory entities, and manages singleton instance.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract method providing access to ProfileDao operations.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Abstract method providing access to ConnectionDao operations.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Abstract method providing access to TransferHistoryDao operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating or reusing the database, with a fallback to in-memory database on failure.
